description.fun: Igglybuff is so soft and bouncy that it gets around by bouncing like a ball, though once it starts it can't always stop. It loves to sing, but its vocal cords aren't developed yet, so it keeps getting sore throats and gargles with stream water to soothe them. Praise it, though, and its singing slowly gets better.
description.guide: A small, pink, balloon-like baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 2. It moves by bouncing and loves to sing, though its underdeveloped vocal cords often leave it with a sore throat. It evolves into Jigglypuff with high friendship.
description.tagline: A bouncy baby singer who's always a little hoarse

description.fun: Once Jigglypuff has your attention, it fills its huge lungs and sings a lullaby that sends anyone listening to sleep, tuning its voice to the brain waves of a sleeper. Its range tops 12 octaves. It can be caught in the wild in more main-series games than any other Pokémon, and with Pikachu it was on the very first Wizards Black Star Promo cards.
description.guide: A round, pink, balloon-like Normal and Fairy Pokémon. It mesmerises opponents with its eyes, then sings a lullaby that puts listeners to sleep. It evolves from Igglybuff and evolves into Wigglytuff with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: A round pink singer whose lullaby nobody stays awake for

description.fun: Wigglytuff's fur is so fine and soft that anyone who touches it, even another Wigglytuff, never wants to stop; it sheds each season, and people spin the fur into yarn. Its rubbery body can inflate up to 20 times its size, and Wigglytuff hold contests to see who can puff up the most. In a bad mood, it balloons to an enormous size to scare foes away.
description.guide: The final stage of Igglybuff's line, a pink, rabbit-eared Normal and Fairy Pokémon with extremely soft fur. Its rubbery body can inflate to many times its normal size, and it puffs up to scare off opponents. It evolves from Jigglypuff with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: Puffs up 20 times its size, and you'll never stop petting it

note.text: Igglybuff is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 2, a generation after the Jigglypuff it grows into.
